## Checklist

- [ ] **No personal data:** no names, handles, emails, phone numbers, churches, places, or personal paths.
- [ ] **Full references:** Bible and scripture references are written in full (book, chapter, verse), never "v. 16".
- [ ] **Edition named:** every quoted translation or edition is named.
- [ ] **Own-sources rule:** each tradition is described from its own primary sources, as its adherents would; nothing invented or unverified.
- [ ] **Additive:** new packs, sections, or opt-in settings rather than rewriting others' views; no new defaults.
- [ ] Links checked (`python3 tools/check_links.py`) and the privacy check passes (`python3 tools/check_privacy.py`).
- [ ] I am / am not an adherent of the tradition(s) affected: <!-- say which -->
